positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Terraform · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Microservices · Node.js · Distributed Systems · OpenID Connect · OAuth

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
+ Built front end experiences in React to capture customer data and improve conversion rates
+ Built backend projects in Python using test driven development with a focus on reusability
+ Created and managed A/B tests to determine if new features are objectively improving Cratejoy.com
+ Collaborated with design team using Sketch and Zeppelin to create user experience and design requirements

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
+ Optimized image compression algorithm for user uploaded jpegs reducing file size by 15%
+ Built in-app notification system in React to notify marketplace consumers when their subscriptions had expired
+ Built a headless content management system using Flask and Python to create and customize blog posts
+ Integrated Cratejoy's marketplace with 3rd party tools using Javascript and REST APIs

positions.title: Merchant Success Engineer
positions.description:
I solved technical and business problems for Cratejoy's merchants, end subscribers and Cratejoy's Customer Support team.
+ Developed features and fix bugs that touch all of our services including Cratejoy's API and Seller applications
+ Owned our Zendesk application which makes cross-origin requests to Cratejoy's Admin service to help Customer Support solve tickets faster
+ Worked with our top sellers to fix front end issues, diagnose potential backend bugs and run custom business reports via SQL
+ Responsible for influencing and reporting on customer support ticket metrics including first time to reply, full resolution time and percent of tickets that were solved via automation

positions.title: Business Development Leader
positions.description: I am responsible for creating and executing sales growth plans for multi-million dollar accounts in the North America distributed control systems market. I provide sales forecasting analysis by managing a pipeline projected out five years. I work with our sales channel and engineering centers to provide recommendations on competitive pricing to win complex projects. I have developed internal tools to provide more accurate and timely analysis and reporting to arm our teams with better data in a pressure packed sales environment.

positions.title: eBusiness Marketing Manager
positions.description:
Responsible for developing the eBusiness strategy and execution for the Process Systems & Solutions business unit.
+ Developed support portal that allows Emerson customers to create and track orders online while synchronizing order history with Emerson databases.
+ Launched market insights study to better understand customer habits, how they perceive current Emerson offerings and their willingness to trust Emerson with eBusiness capabilities

positions.title: Technical MBA Intern
positions.description:
Dual responsibilities:
+ Responsible for creating and managing Web 2.0 tools using HTML for communication/collaboration withing IBM's Cloud Competitive Action Team.
+ Market analysis of IBM's main cloud competition providing insight into business models and messaging

positions.title: Extreme Blue MBA Intern
positions.description:
Managed three-person technical team to develop a Chrome browser extension with social media capabilities for retail product discovery. Created business plan and road map to align with IBM’s growth objectives.
+ Agile
+ Project management
+ Market analysis

positions.title: Business Development Associate
positions.description:
Responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies to meet corporate objectives. Primary content owner and developer of marcomm activities including:
+ Company website
+ Print/Web media
+ Advertising
+ Tradeshow branding/collateral

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
Created and qualified test programs for a multi-million dollar piece of equipment designed for testing memory chip reliability. Primary engineering contact to manufacturing and service technicians to ensure test floor was operating at optimal utilization.
+ C++
+ Linux
+ Data Analysis
